items.effect: Increases the power of the holder's binding/trapping moves.

items.effect: Slightly lowers the accuracy of opposing moves aimed at the holder.

items.effect: Raises the holder's Speed by 50% but locks it into the first move it uses.

items.effect: Automatically switches the holder out after it takes damage from an attack.

items.effect: Boosts the power of the holder's super-effective moves.

items.name: Focus Band
items.effect: Gives the holder a random chance to survive an otherwise fatal hit with 1 HP.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.effect: If the holder is at full HP, lets it survive an otherwise fatal hit with 1 HP; works once.

items.name: Iron Ball
items.effect: Halves the holder's Speed and removes its immunity to Ground-type moves.

items.name: King's Rock

items.name: Leek
items.effect: Sharply raises the critical-hit ratio of its holder's moves.

items.name: Leftovers
items.effect: Restores a small amount of the holder's HP at the end of every turn.

items.name: Life Orb
items.effect: Boosts the power of the holder's moves by 30%, but the holder loses 10% of its max HP after attacking.

items.name: Light Ball
items.effect: Raises the holder's Attack and Sp. Atk.

items.name: Light Clay
items.effect: Extends the duration of screens (Light Screen, Reflect, etc.) the holder sets up.

items.name: Mental Herb
items.effect: Frees the holder from one binding or infatuation-style effect; works once.

items.name: Metronome
items.effect: Increases the power of a move by 20% each time it's used consecutively, up to a 100% bonus.

items.name: Muscle Band
items.effect: Slightly boosts the power of the holder's physical moves.

items.name: Quick Claw
items.effect: Gives the holder a random chance to act first in a turn, regardless of Speed.

items.name: Red Card
items.effect: Forces the attacking Pokémon out of battle when the holder takes damage.

items.name: Rocky Helmet
items.effect: Damages any attacker that hits the holder with a contact move.

items.name: Scope Lens
items.effect: Raises the holder's critical-hit ratio.

items.name: Shed Shell
items.effect: Guarantees the holder can switch out, even against trapping effects.

items.name: Shell Bell
